title: The Guardrails
sub: Not about winning a deal — about not blowing up the company. The doctrine IS the product.

title: Organize & reflect. Never conclude.
displayText: Revelation is safe. Conclusion is not.
say: We show what's present, what's missing, and where it came from. What it means is the attorney's call.
note: We may reveal the record. We may never say what it proves, whether there's a claim, or what it's worth.

title: Six bright lines
displayText: Each has a wrong line and a safe line.
note: 1 No case-scoring · 2 No legal deadlines · 3 No dollar value · 4 No referral/fee-split · 5 No guarantees · 6 No claim of flawlessness.

title: Case scoring
displayText: The UPL trap — and the thing firms most want to hear.
never: Our AI finds and ranks the strongest cases before your team touches them.
say: We show how complete the record is against what the law requires — your attorney decides.

title: Legal deadlines
displayText: Calculating a statute of limitations is practicing law.
never: Your claim has to be filed by this date.
say: The system surfaces the dates on the record; your attorney calculates any deadlines.
note: We show dates. We never compute them.

title: The value of a claim
displayText: Describe the record, not the case.
never: This case is strong / worth about $X / likely to settle.
say: We describe what's on the record — documents, timeline, gaps. What it's worth is the attorney's judgment.

title: Referral fees & fee-splitting
displayText: §6155 + the Rules of Professional Conduct. This one can end the company.
never: We send you cases for a cut. / Pricing is per case or per client.
say: The worker's record is free and exportable, the worker chooses the firm, and the firm pays a flat subscription for the software. Clean money only.

sources.label: CA Bus. & Prof. Code §6155 + CRPC 5.4 (fee-splitting / referral)

title: Guarantees
displayText: We change the quality of the file — never the outcome of the case.
never: You'll win. / We improve win rates and settlement amounts.
say: We make the record complete and reviewable so the attorney can decide faster.

title: Over-claiming accuracy
displayText: We compete on auditability, not on being perfect.
never: Our AI is flawless / never makes mistakes.
say: We use AI to organize, and every fact links to its source page — anything can be verified in one click.
note: Honesty here is strength. We use AI too; the difference is provenance.

title: The discipline is the moat
displayText: Not handcuffs — the reason a compliant firm can hire us.
note: Every rival that scores, values, or takes a cut has taken on legal risk. Our refusal to conclude is why we're hirable. Sell it proudly.

title: Unsure? It probably crosses the line.
sub: Say less, cite more, route the hard question to counsel. Describe the record — let the attorney decide.
